**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The only MFN mechanic in the Agreement runs in IBM's favour: MSL engineering is priced to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis (p1099). Cross-checks for reciprocal language ("no less favorable", "more favorable terms", "best price", "favorable", "match", "preferential", "lowest", "first refusal") surfaced nothing obliging IBM to extend MSL any better terms given to third parties; the tooling right-to-match (p1104) and right of first refusal (p1230) are also Customer-side benefits. Per the playbook, we mark this compliant and leave the Vendor-granted MFN untouched.
